assessment: This ancillary study from the BLADE study provided valuable findings regarding FSH as a predictor of sarcopenic obesity in patients using the LHRH antagonist Degarelix, suggesting a potential direct effect of FSH on fat. The study design and analysis were solid, and the limitations of the study such as the small sample size and lack of sex hormone analysis-were properly addressed.
